speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe right groin pain. I also have Pain in both knees, Right leg is slightly shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Hip Dislocation. The history of a rear-end collision (seatbelt injury mechanism) combined with the classic presentation of the right leg being shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated is pathognomonic for this injury. The bilateral knee pain suggests a complex mechanism of injury or associated fractures, but the hip dislocation is the primary diagnosis requiring immediate reduction.
